      "most_likely_effort": 16

U7: Add an 'escape' string property to FlatFileItemWriterBuilder (and equivalent on DelimitedLineAggregator) and update Aggregator implementations to honor it when writing fields.

U8: Refactor MessageBus to a stage-based pipeline (Producer -> Transformer -> Consumer) implemented as non-blocking reactive stages (or pre-sized thread pools with bounded queues) to remove the synchronous transformation bottleneck.
Use JUnit 5 and Mockito for unit tests; use an embedded H2 and an in-process HDFS mock (MiniDFSCluster) for integration tests.
Use Maven multi-module structure; no changes to public API of Spring Framework core itself.
assumptions: The developer has full read/write access to the existing Spring Batch source tree and can run the full build locally.
Megastore client library and an HDFS client are already available on the classpath; this increment does not include writing those adapters.
Spring Expression Language is already a transitive dependency and does not need to be added explicitly.
No new third-party dependencies are required for U1, U2, U3, U4, U5, U7.
Performance/throughput validation for U8 can be done with an in-house micro-benchmark harness; no new external profiling tools are introduced.
Backward compatibility is preserved: existing job/reader/writer configurations continue to work unchanged.
Internationalization, accessibility, and end-user UI work are out of scope (this is a framework, not an application).
Effort estimates are for one experienced Java/Spring developer working in isolation, including coding, local testing, and self-review.
No code freeze or release-management overhead is included; CI is assumed to be available and stable.
Documentation refers to Javadoc, reference manual updates, and a short migration/usage note; no marketing or website work.

activities.activity_description: Read all eight user stories, study the existing Spring Batch modules touched (batch-core, batch-infrastructure, jdbc, hdfs, messaging), produce a short design note describing option objects, extension points, the MessageBus pipeline, and the test strategy. Confirm APIs and dependencies before coding.

Extract hard-coded CodeGen options into a CodeGenOptions class (Builder + immutable POJO), wire it through the CodeGen entry points and job parameters, ensure existing callers still work, and add unit tests for the new parameterization path.

Introduce a MergeOptions class, expose it as a job/launch parameter, adapt the megastore consumer so it can incrementally consume deltas using the supplied options, and add unit + light integration tests against a mock megastore client.

Add a 'timeout' property to JobParameters/JobLauncher, implement a watchdog that interrupts the executing job thread on timeout, ensure resources and step execution context are released cleanly, and cover the happy path, the timeout path, and the just-in-time completion race with unit tests.

activities.activity_name: U4 - SQL Statement/Script Processor and Job
activities.activity_description: Create StatementProcessor and ScriptProcessor ItemProcessor implementations (plus a Job-level SQL helper) that use JdbcTemplate/ScriptUtils to execute SQL. Support parameter binding from the current StepExecution/JobExecution context, transaction semantics, and unit tests with an embedded H2.

activities.activity_name: U5 - Custom RowMapper support in NameColumnJdbcItemReader
activities.activity_description: Add an overload/setter for a custom RowMapper<Tuple> on NameColumnJdbcItemReader, introduce a protected afterMapRow(Tuple) hook so enrichment (e.g. timestamp, delete flag) can be done without rebuilding the Tuple, and add unit tests covering the custom-mapper and afterMapRow paths.

Introduce a ResourceSuffixCreator interface and an ExpressionResourceSuffixCreator implementation using SpEL, wire it into FlatFileItemWriter and the HDFS writer so paths can be derived from timestamp / ExecutionContext values, and add unit + integration tests for several expression scenarios.

Add 'shouldQuoteIfEscapeSet' and 'escape' configuration to DelimitedLineTokenizer/LineAggregator, update the default aggregator implementations to honor the escape character, and add focused unit tests verifying Hive/HAWQ-compatible CSV output.

Profile the current MessageBus to identify transformation hot spots, refactor the message pipeline into composable stages with bounded thread pools / queues so producers and consumers are not serialized, run micro-benchmark before/after, and add regression tests for ordering and error-propagation invariants.

activities.activity_name: Unit test suite for the increment
activities.activity_description: Extend the unit-test coverage for all eight user stories: parameter binding, timeout races, custom RowMapper, SpEL file naming, escape characters, and MessageBus pipeline behavior. Aim for line coverage on the new/changed code paths.

Build integration tests that exercise the full flow: job launch with timeout, SQL processor against H2, JDBC item reader with custom RowMapper writing to a mock HDFS, expression-based paths, and MessageBus throughput smoke test. Verify no regressions in the existing batch-test suite.

Update Javadoc on all new public APIs, add reference-manual sections for each new feature (parameterized options, timeout, SQL processor, custom RowMapper, expression naming, escape, MessageBus), and provide a short migration/usage note for existing users.
